domain_guidance.summary: The Business Technology domain covers the nature and structure of organisations, including types of business entities, organisational design, and the role of technology in business processes and operations.

The Organizational Context domain examines external environments, stakeholder relationships, corporate governance, ethical considerations and legal obligations that influence business decisions and strategic outcomes across varied operating contexts and sectors.

The Leading and Managing People domain focuses on leadership theories, motivation, team dynamics, performance appraisal and personal effectiveness within a business setting and across organisational levels and structures.

editorial.overview: The Business and Technology (BT/F1) exam, offered by ACCA, evaluates candidates on business technology, organisational context and leading people. It consists of 100 objective and constructed‑response questions, delivered in a linear format over 120 minutes. Successful candidates earn a current ACCA certification that requires renewal to remain active.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Start by reviewing the official ACCA syllabus and technical articles for each domain. Combine free OpenTuition lecture notes with practice questions, then take timed mock exams to build stamina for the 120‑minute linear format. Review incorrect answers and focus on weak areas before the exam day.
editorial.who_should_take: Professionals aiming to move into roles such as business analyst, technology manager, or people‑leadership positions will benefit. Ideal for those with some experience in accounting or business environments who need a solid grounding in organisational structures and technology impacts.

exam_rules: Closed-book. Scientific calculators permitted (non-programmable, non-financial). No graphical or financial calculators. No phones or electronic devices. Scratch paper provided.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID required. Name on ID must match ACCA registration exactly.

official_study_resources.notes: Free past exam papers, examiners' reports, and technical articles

renewal_options: Passed exams do not expire. Once qualified, ACCA members must complete 40 CPD hours per year (21 verifiable hours minimum). Annual membership subscription required to maintain active ACCA status.

retake_policy.notes: Maximum 4 attempts per exam in total for Applied Knowledge CBEs (on-demand). Applied Skills and Strategic Professional: 4 exam sessions per year (March, June, September, December). Full exam fee required for each retake.

testing_centers.notes: Computer-Based Exams (CBE) at Pearson VUE test centers globally; paper-based exams available in some regions
